string.name: max_iob_scaled_tsunami
string.comment: Ends the sentence 'Limiting IOB to %1$.1f U because of …'. %1$d=profile percentage used for the scaling. Example: max value in preferences at 130% profile during Tsunami

resources.string: max value in preferences at %1$d%% profile during Tsunami
During a Tsunami session, allow more max IOB while BG is above 180 mg/dL and still rising. More insulin can cause a low later. Off by default.
Added to max IOB while the rule above applies. The hard limit still wins.
